comment: Algorithma AI data policy (Swiss FADP data minimisation). AI-visible data = Odoo permission INTERSECTION this policy: a field listed under deny is removed from every read tool, odoo:// resource and knowledge index, and aggregating on it is rejected - even when Odoo's ACL lets the human see it. Enforced by ERPipe's field ACL (docs/field-acl.md); activate with ODOO_MCP_FIELD_POLICY_FILE=<this file> or merge the field_acl block into odoo_mcp_policy.json. Keys are instance names; 'default' applies to an ODOO_URL/ODOO_DB env deployment and is the fallback for any instance without its own block.
